mapper.select: SELECT ob.outbound_id AS "outboundId", ob.outbound_no AS "outboundNo", ob.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_no AS "salesOrderNo", w.warehouse_name AS "warehouseName", ob.status AS "status" FROM outbound ob JOIN sales_order so ON so.sales_order_id = ob.sales_order_id JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = ob.warehouse_id WHERE ob.outbound_id = #{outboundId}

SELECT ob.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", oi.sales_order_item_id AS "salesOrderItemId", oi.base_shipped_qty AS "baseShippedQty", soi.base_ordered_qty AS "baseOrderedQty", soi.shipped_qty AS "shippedQty", soi.version AS "version" FROM outbound ob JOIN outbound_item oi ON oi.outbound_id = ob.outbound_id JOIN sales_order_item soi ON soi.sales_order_item_id = oi.sales_order_item_id WHERE ob.outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY oi.line_no

UPDATE sales_order so SET shipment_status = CASE
WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item soi WHERE soi.sales_order_id = so.sales_order_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item soi WHERE soi.sales_order_id = so.sales_order_id AND soi.shipped_qty < soi.base_ordered_qty ) THEN 'SHIPPED'
WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item soi WHERE soi.sales_order_id = so.sales_order_id AND soi.shipped_qty > 0 ) THEN 'PARTIAL'
ELSE 'NOT_SHIPPED' END,
updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE so.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND so.company_id = #{companyId} AND so.order_status = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.select: SELECT so.company_id AS "companyId", so.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_status AS "orderStatus", soi.product_id AS "productId", soi.base_ordered_qty AS "baseOrderedQty", soi.shipped_qty AS "shippedQty", pu.conversion_qty AS "conversionQty" FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.sales_order_id = soi.sales_order_id JOIN product_unit pu ON pu.product_unit_id = #{productUnitId} AND pu.product_id = soi.product_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = soi.product_id WHERE soi.sales_order_item_id = #{salesOrderItemId} AND pu.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.use_yn = 'Y'
